# noah

> noah is an iPhone app that turns what you dream about into a personal prayer. You tell noah what's on your heart in your own words, and it writes a prayer around your actual life, then reads it to you in a warm voice with soft music.

- Website: https://get-noah.com/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/noah-pray-your-way/id6535647463
- Made by: Noah Technology, Inc., founded by Farisa Magazieva
- Contact: hello@get-noah.com

## What noah does

- Turns your hopes into a personal prayer: a new job, love and a future spouse, healing, family, money and provision, a home, peace of mind at night.
- Reads each prayer aloud in a warm voice with soft music.
- Saves prayers to a personal library with matching artwork so you can listen again.
- Lets you type or speak what's on your mind.
- Languages: English, German and Spanish.

## Pricing and availability

- Free to download on iPhone (iOS 17 or later). A subscription is required to create prayers. Trial availability is shown in the app.
- Not available on Android yet.

## Good to know

- noah helps people put their own hopes into words. It does not speak for God, guarantee outcomes, or replace religious guidance, therapy, medical care or emergency services.
